subject: Windows 7/Rstudio/Rattle - rattle() Causes R Session to abort

messages.author: 9f222b213b22a090
messages.subject: Windows 7/Rstudio/Rattle - rattle() Causes R Session to abort
parts:
Windows 7, R 2.15.1 64bit, RStudio 0.97.312, Rattle 2.6.26
 
Hi Graham,
 
Please help.
 
I removed rattle then reinstalled then loaded then attempted to open rattle with rattle(). But each time I do that My R session in R studio aborts and restarts.
 
 remove.packages("rattle")
install.packages("rattle")
library(rattle)
 
How can I fix this? I saw something in rattle-users but that applied to Mac.
 
Dan

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Windows 7/Rstudio/Rattle - rattle() Causes R Session to abort
parts:
As a first step, install the latest version of R and RStudio.

Ensure RGtk2 is installed.

Install the current beta release of rattle:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Exit from R/RStudio and start them up again.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
